sequence_length_quality_caveat: No truncation does not establish classification quality above the encoder nominal512 position setting. Relative attention and position_biased_input=false describe implementation configuration, not validation of long-sequence accuracy.

source_evidence.classification: classify_text max_len=None passes through extract/batch_extract to ExtractorCollator(max_len=None).
